title: Correct x-component
description: Essential: Student correctly calculates F_x = F1*cos37° - F3 = 20*0.8 - 10 = 6 N.

title: Correct y-component
description: Essential: Student correctly calculates F_y = F1*sin37° - F2 = 20*0.6 - 6 = 6 N.

title: Magnitude via Pythagorean theorem
description: Important: Student correctly applies F_all = sqrt(F_x² + F_y²) to find the magnitude.

title: Direction via arctangent
description: Important: Student correctly finds direction angle φ = arctan(F_y/F_x) relative to positive x-axis.

title: Sign convention consistency
description: Important: Student consistently uses positive for right/up and negative for left/down in component calculations.

title: Unit inclusion
description: Optional: Student includes correct units (N for force, degrees for angle) with final answers.

title: Incorrect component signs
description: Pitfall: Student makes sign errors in force components (e.g., adding F3 instead of subtracting).

title: Wrong trigonometric function
description: Pitfall: Student uses sin/cos incorrectly for F1 components (e.g., swaps sin37° and cos37°).
